caption:
Google Labs repositioned CC, its experimental AI agent, from a personal productivity tool into a shared household assistant for up to six family members. The shift came from user demand: families asked CC to help manage school schedules, sports, bills, and meal plans. The updated CC organizes those logistics into a shared daily brief and calendar, and it can take action on its own: pre-filling forms, drafting meal plans, checking drive times from Google Maps. There's a significant limit, though. It's U.S.-only, requires you to be 18 or older with a personal Gmail account, and school-provided accounts aren't supported.
